property_summary: For any non-zero newOwner and when called by the current owner, transferOwnership(newOwner) sets owner() == newOwner; the mutant that unconditionally sets owner = address(0) will violate this (owner becomes zero) for some fuzzed newOwner inputs.
change_summary: Replace assignment owner = newOwner; with owner = address(0); so transferOwnership clears owner to the zero address regardless of the provided address.
